notes: Bit-exact algorithm (straight 8-bit, as AE): L8 = round(255*(0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B)) (Rec.601, rounded to 8 bits BEFORE the ramp); colours quantised round-half-up; tinted = round(black + (white - black) * L8/255); out = round(lerp(orig, tinted, Amount/100)); alpha untouched, then premultiplied. Only residual offline: 1 pixel at an exact luma tie (188,14,255 -> AE 93, float noise). Amount < 100 has no visible ref: the lerp/rounding order is the natural one (<= 1/255 if AE rounds differently). AE 4 'Swap Colors' is a button (no value, no image effect) and AE 5 'Compositing Options' (effect opacity / masks, common to all effects) are not parameters of the shader. Colour alpha is ignored (AE colours have none). Rive residuals are not from the shader: fxlib.argb_hex uses Python round() (half-to-even) so 0.3*255 = 76.5 -> 76 instead of AE's 77 (blue channel -1 on tint_1), and the Rive composite adds a +-1 dither-like noise on ~2-3 % of pixels (reproduced with a constant-colour shader; it toggles with unrelated inputs).

measured.offline_px_off: 1 pixel per setting (exact luma tie), off by 1/255
